For many communities in Idaho, health care providers are often miles and miles away. Rural health care providers are vital to keep Idaho healthy. On #NationalRuralHealthDay, we thank these providers for meeting the challenging demands of rural healthcare.

Improvements to soil health have long-lasting and significant economic benefits to Idaho’s agriculture industry. I’m glad to see Idaho’s own Tim Cornie reap the benefits of successful soil management.
It’s National Osteopathic Medicine Week! I’m proud to celebrate with @IdahoCOM and recognize their commitment to train the next generation of physicians and medical professionals.

Responsible and informed financial decisions daily create an important base for Idahoans’ long and short-term economic health—lessens the federal government also should learn. 

This Financial Literacy Month is a great time to evaluate your family’s finances and look for ways to improve. Personal financial health is so important, especially during times of high inflation, increased housing costs, and other economic stresses we all face today.
